title: Gritty Monochromatic Album Cover
coreRelationships: The bright light streak across the eyes creates a strong focal point and obscures identity.
The dark, textured background provides a stark contrast to the bright elements and adds to the gritty mood.
The hand-drawn script in the upper left balances the composition with its organic form against the structured portrait.
The smaller, distressed text at the bottom provides a secondary textual element without competing with the primary title.
reuseFormula: Generate a monochromatic portrait with a strong grunge overlay. Introduce a bright, horizontal light streak across the subject's eyes. Overlay custom-drawn script text in the upper left and distressed sans-serif text in the lower center, ensuring both integrate with the gritty texture. Add a standard Parental Advisory label in the top right.
